{{Quote|Pesfavri is the nearest Defense Fleet base. You know the coordinates?&raquo;''<br />''&laquo;Yes.|Admiral Ar'alani and Syndic Mitth'ras'safis|<ref name="Outbound" />|translated=1}}
'''Pesfavri''' was an [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]]. A [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]], it housed a base of the [[Chiss Defense Fleet|Defense Fleet]] of the Chiss Ascendancy. As Defense Fleet [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]] was escorting the detained Chiss [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] off the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout ship/Legends|exploration]] and [[Colony ship/Legends|colonization vessel]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' after it had been [[Battle for Outbound Flight|crippled]] by Mitth'raw'nuruodo's forces in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], the [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Jorj Car'das]] and [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]] of the Chiss [[Mitth family/Legends|Eighth Ruling Family]] informed the admiral of their intent to remain aboard the ship.

Shortly before that, the group had formulated a plan to take the vessel to the Defense Fleet so as to deny the [[Chaf family/Legends|Fifth Ruling Family]] the possibility to acquire the ship and the technology aboard it. Ar'alani, believing that Mitth'ras'safis intended to go through with the plan, noted that the installation at Pesfavri was the closest to their [[Unidentified Unknown Regions star system (red sun)|location]]. In reality, however, the Syndic planned to scuttle the ''Outbound Flight'' in a nearby [[Star/Legends|star]], although the vessel was ultimately flown into [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]] [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] instead.

==Description==
{{Quote|You really think we can get this thing all the way to a military base?|Jorj Car'das, to Syndic Mitth'ras'safis, on the ''Outbound Flight''|<ref name="Outbound" />|translated=1}}
Pesfavri was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Pesfavri" /> located in the [[Pesfavri system/Legends|Pesfavri system]], a part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Situated far from the core territory of the Chiss Ascendancy, it lay along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Way of Schesa]], which linked it to that area's [[Schesa system/Legends|Schesa system]] as well as the even more remote [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] known as [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|We need to take Outbound Flight to a military base immediately and have it declared Defense Fleet property.|Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo|<ref name="Outbound" />|translated=1}}
One of the many worlds [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="CSWE Pesfavri" /> of the Chiss Ascendancy, Pesfavri was the site of a [[Chiss Defense Fleet]] base.<ref name="Outbound" /> In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> a force of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]]&mdash;also [[Core name/Legends|known]] as Thrawn&mdash;of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] [[Battle for Outbound Flight|crippled]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout ship/Legends|exploration]] and [[Colony ship/Legends|colonization vessel]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' after he had come to view it as a future security threat to the Ascendancy and after negotiations with the ship's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leader, [[Jorus C'baoth]], had broken down. When [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]]&mdash;also known as Thrass&mdash;of the Chiss [[Mitth family/Legends|Eighth Ruling Family]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Jorj Car'das]] informed Thrawn that a [[Chaf'orm'bintrano's fleet|fleet]] led by [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]] of the [[Chaf family/Legends|Fifth Ruling Family]] was approaching the [[Unidentified Unknown Regions star system (red sun)|battle site]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] became convinced that the Aristocra would attempt to claim possession of the damaged ''Outbound Flight'' for the Fifth Family.<ref name="Outbound" />

[[File:OutboundFlight-SotGSE.png|thumb|right|300px|Admiral Ar'alani named Pesfavri as the location of the nearest Defense Fleet base to which the damaged starship ''Outbound Flight'' (pictured) could be taken in order to prevent it from falling into the possession of the Fifth Ruling Family.]]
Thrawn, Thrass, Car'das, and [[Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]] of the Chiss Defense Fleet, who were all aboard the vessel at the [[Time/Legends|time]], realized that the technology present aboard the ship, if it were to be acquired by any single Chiss [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Family]], would lead to severe [[Politics/Legends|political]] instability in the region, agreeing that the best course of action would be to instead have the ''Outbound Flight'' be declared Defense Fleet property at one of its bases. At that moment, however, Chaf'orm'bintrano contacted Ar'alani and ordered her to detain Thrawn due to accusations of violating Chiss [[Defensive-only doctrine|non-interventionist policies]] that had been levied against the commander.<ref name="Outbound" />

The admiral was forced to comply with the order and escort Thrawn and his [[Chiss warrior/Legends|soldiers]] to the Aristocra's [[Chaf Exalted|ship]]; Car'das and Thrass, however, both declared to her their intention to stay aboard the Republic vessel. Before her departure, Ar'alani, who believed Thrass was planning to take the ''Outbound Flight'' to a Defense Fleet base, informed the Syndic that the installation at Pesfavri, the coordinates of which Thrass knew, was the nearest to their location.<ref name="Outbound" />

Thrass subsequently revealed to Car'das that his true intention, in order to prevent any of the Ruling Families from claiming possession of the ''Outbound Flight'', was to instead scuttle the presumed-lifeless ship in the nearby [[Star/Legends|star]]. The pair proceeded with the plan until they encountered [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Lorana Jinzler]], who, unbeknownst to Thrawn and his companions, was one among a small group of the ''Outbound Flight''{{'s}} crewmembers and passengers who had survived the Chiss attack on the ship. After realizing that evacuating the ship and destroying it before it was captured by the Fifth Family was not possible, Thrass suggested that they follow Thrawn's original plan of taking the vessel to a Defense Fleet base. However, Thrass, Jinzler, and Car'das soon realized that such a course of action would effectively render the survivors of the ''Outbound Flight'' captives of the Chiss, so Thrass and Jinzler ultimately flew the ship into<ref name="Outbound" /> the Redoubt star cluster instead.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pesfavri was first mentioned in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square G-8.<ref name="TEA" /> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' implies that the ''Outbound Flight'' did not reach Pesfavri due to the damage suffered by its [[Engine/Legends|drive]] systems,<ref name="CSWE Pesfavri" /> while in actuality individuals present aboard the vessel twice dismissed the planet as a potential destination in favor of others before the ship had even begun its flight from the site it had been attacked at.<ref name="Outbound" />
